title: Procurement Signal Workbench: Synthesize market telemetry into GTM triggers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reproducible workbench that converts raw market telemetry (model availability, pricing deltas, latency shifts, quantization compatibility, and enterprise procurement signals) into actionable GTM and procurement triggers. The output should be a prioritized list of trigger definitions (conditions + recommended actions) and a lightweight dashboard + alerting spec for Sales/PS/Platform teams. This ticket scopes the product requirements, data sources, core hypotheses, and experimental plan for validating signals with account teams.
acceptance_criteria: Spec for signal definitions: at least 8 distinct telemetry signals with threshold logic and recommended action templates
Microbenchmark matrix with results for 10 candidate models (latency, cost-per-token, memory footprint, quantization compatibility)
Survey run with 12 AE/CS leads and synthesis of procurement sensitivity thresholds
Dashboard mock showing top-10 accounts by model-substitution-risk and a rule-based alerting flow
Actionable GTM playbook with 3 templated outreach scripts for Sales/PS tied to signal severity
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Research, Sales Eng, and Infra to align scope; identified initial telemetry sources (prometheus, billing kafka, model-catalog API)
2026-03-01: Lightweight microbenchmark harness prototyped by Eng (repo: github.com/redwood-inference/pm-procurement-workbench, PR #42)
2026-03-05: Ran first-pass benchmarks on 6 open models across 2 regions; preliminary latency and memory profiles uploaded to /drive/procurement-workbench/results-q1
2026-03-09: Conducted 8 interviews with AE pilots; consensus: account procurement teams react when sustained latency delta >20% or price increase >15%
2026-03-12: PM deck draft completed and reviewed with GTM leadership; requested to include explicit ok-to-deprioritize rules to avoid alert fatigue
decisions: Signal custody: infra will publish normalized telemetry feeds; PM will own signal-to-trigger mapping and playbook
Threshold heuristics: use 30-day rolling windows; default sensitivity set to medium (latency +20%, price +12%) with tiered escalation
Alert destinations: high-severity alerts -> Sales Ops + Account Lead Slack channel; medium -> weekly digest + CS touch
Scope: initial launch will target Enterprise vertical accounts only (top 150 by ARR) to limit noise and measure lift
tradeoffs_and_risks: False positives vs. missed churn: aggressive thresholds generate noise, conservative thresholds miss procurement windows
Data latency: billing and model-catalog updates can lag; offline corrections may be needed before firing alerts
Engineering load: accurate microbenchmarks across many models/hardware combinations is costly; we'll prioritize models covering 80% of consumption
GTM coordination: Sales Ops calendar constraints may delay validation experiments with account teams
next_steps: Finalize signal taxonomy and JSON schema for rule engine by 2026-03-18
Complete microbenchmarks for remaining 4 candidate models by 2026-03-25
Instrument normalized telemetry feeds (billing kafka topic + model-catalog API) with Infra by 2026-03-22
Run a 4-week pilot with 6 enterprise accounts; measure AE engagement lift and contract momentum (pilot window 2026-03-28 to 2026-04-25)
Prepare GTM playbook + templates and get sign-off from Sales VP by 2026-03-30
